designDecisions: D1 (owner, verbatim: "remove any omniroute"): run covers the billing chain AND removes OmniRoute entirely — _wxAI/routing/omniroute/, the omniroute route value (policy.mjs, compare.mjs, agentRuns.ts zod enum, agentrun.ts, agentruns.route CHECK), SPEC-143 FR-008 and the OmniRoute parts of FR-007/FR-009, SCOPE-143 doc, tests (omniroute.test.ts, policy/compare cases), contracts. Route is always official.

D2 (owner, verbatim: "ok on d2"): agentruns gains companyid set server-side from the token that sent the run, never trusted from the record; the project must be one the company may bill (own, or engaged client project with a live assignment, as SPEC-005 FR-014). Hand-applied migration.

D3 (owner, verbatim: "yes" to recommendations): forward.mjs authenticates with the existing project API token (SPEC-097, bound to one project); stored per machine, never committed, never shipped in the public kit.

D4 (owner, "yes"): the agent-run pull runs automatically when the Time & Billing page loads its range and when a statement is generated; idempotent via idx_projecttimeentries_agentpull; manual /agent-pull kept; no background scheduler.

D5 (owner, "yes"): kit setup runs _wxAI/routing/install.mjs and asks for the project token so every consumer app records and forwards runs; runs recorded for every project, billed only where the project is Billable.
D6 (owner, "yes"): retire AgentRunBillingService and its failing tests; AgentRunPullService is the only agentruns -> time entry path.
